penalty: lambda_internal=S*alpha; S=max absolute base-FM Ising h,J; zero S gives zero lambda
fixed_models: reuse validated fixed_fm_pilot checkpoints and QUBOs; 20 initial points; rank2,120 epochs,Adam lr0.1; no retraining
sa: 4 batches x 250 reads; 1000 sweeps; geometric; automatic beta range saved; sampler seed=model_seed*100+rep*100000+batch, same across alpha
beta_range_caveat: Neal default beta range changes with penalized BQM; sweep diagnoses the operational sampler including its default schedule, not penalty alone at fixed temperature
candidate_rule: shared pilot score_candidates: invalid/training/pool duplicates rejected, up to5 unseen candidates ranked by base FM; no refill
bb_budget: initial20 plus max5 logical confirmations per repetition; repetitions are separate diagnostics, not cumulative BBO; offline full192 truth scoring excluded from solver budget
metrics: batch any feasible/unseen feasible/at least5 unseen success frequencies over10 repetitions
conditional unseen effective diversity exp(Shannon entropy)
conditional unseen mean base-FM gap to feasible global FM minimum
raw/batch unseen FM top5% and true top5%
accepted proposal true quality and initial-plus-proposals regret
top5pct: 10 of192 candidates (ceil(0.05*192)); stable candidate-ID tie breaking; training points cannot count as new hits
probability_caveat: empirical SA sampling frequencies and repeated-batch success frequencies; not exact Boltzmann or guaranteed independent samples; no 1-(1-p)^1000 inference
statistics: within each model seed average repetitions for each defined metric, report contributing n; across five model seeds median/IQR. Null conditional quality retained when no unseen feasible sample; summary includes defined counts. Paired alpha-vs100 differences and two-sided Wilcoxon; Bonferroni across all predeclared tests; no nonsignificance-as-equivalence
xy: not rerun or penalized; existing lambda0 pilot is separate reference
prevalidation: reuse passed N6/N9/N23 XY circuit and fixed-model artifact checks; new exhaustive penalty energy and hand-counted metric checks before execution
